fomod.Name: SLO VE
fomod.Author: crajjjj
fomod.Description:
Scene voices, facial expressions, body SFX and an optional willpower/resistance system for SexLab. Configured entirely in TOML - no MCM. Runs on AudioUtil for folder-based voice playback and lipsync.
The installer asks which SexLab flavour you run: SexLab Framework P+ (2.x) or classic SexLab Framework SE 1.63 (which additionally requires SexLab Separate Orgasm). The correct script set is installed for you. An optional checkbox silences SLO VE's contact SFX for users of PPA (Accurate Penetration), which plays its own thrust audio.
